llm.summary: This Arista health-check skill is mostly diagnostic, but its read-only label is contradicted by a device configuration command that can restart EOS agents.

dimensions.detail: SSH access and Linux-native EOS diagnostic commands are coherent for Arista switch triage, but configuration-mode restart authority is broader than the declared read-only safety tier.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown documentation only, no executable scripts, no MCP dependencies, and metadata declares no egress endpoints or required environment variables.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most instructions are scoped to show/log/diagnostic collection, but the agent restart step appears as a routine numbered troubleshooting action and lacks an explicit approval, maintenance-window, or change-control gate.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence or credential handling was found, but the documented EOS agent restart uses privileged configuration-mode device authority and may disrupt control-plane services.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is read-only Arista EOS health triage, but the troubleshooting section includes `agent [name] shutdown` and `no agent [name] shutdown`, which are state-changing recovery commands on a network device.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you treat it as a diagnostic plus remediation guide, not a read-only health check. Do not allow an agent to run the EOS agent restart step automatically; require explicit operator approval, confirm the selected agent and blast radius, collect logs first, and use normal network change-control procedures.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted in part: artifact metadata declares `safety: read-only` and `safetyTier: read-only`, while the body later includes a configuration-changing restart step.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted: lines 421-422 instruct restarting an EOS agent via shutdown/no-shutdown despite the skill being presented as a health-check procedure.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted: the text notes this is a config change and says to collect logs first, but it does not require explicit user approval or change control before the restart.
[T05] unexpected: Accepted as a scope mismatch rather than malicious behavior: the artifact does not escalate privileges itself, but it directs use of privileged configuration commands beyond its read-only declaration.
